name: C21 multi-instance script tasks
description: Script tasks as multi-instance activities: a JUEL script in a parallel loop, a JavaScript script in a sequential loop with a result variable (written with setVariable, so one process variable shared by all rounds) and a JavaScript script in a parallel loop driven by a loop cardinality.

scenarios.name: parallel over a collection, sequential with a shared result variable, parallel with a cardinality
no elements and a cardinality of zero run nothing: the result lists are empty and the result variable is never set
a negative loop cardinality rejects the start
